text: Planning a trip is often as exciting as the journey itself. I spent weeks researching flights, booking hostels, and mapping out daily itineraries. When I finally arrived in Vietnam, everything felt new. The bustling streets, the aroma of street food, and the vibrant local markets were overwhelming in the best way. Trying pho and banh mi from small vendors was a highlight, though ordering often involved pointing and smiling due to language barriers. Despite the awkward moments, the locals were patient and kind. Those unexpected connections and beautiful sights created memories I will treasure forever, proving that the best travel experiences come from stepping out of your comfort zone.
